notes.title: Versus Evil Hidden Gems Sale Going on Now!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

Versus Evil will be celebrating its 10-year anniversary this year! We've published many games over the past decade, so today we'd like to shine a light on several hidden gems from our vast catalog.

First up is Antihero, a fast-paced digital board game with an (Oliver) Twist. Recruit street urchins, hire thugs, start a gang, upgrade your guild, steal everything... and bribe, blackmail, and assassinate your way to victory.

Next is Let Them Come, a fast-paced pixel art shoot 'em up. Twitchy trigger fingers and focused battle tactics are the order of the day as wave after wave of alien-like creatures try to take you down.

Then there's Cardpocalypse, where you make friends, play cards, twist the rules, become a Mega Mutant Power Pets master, and try to save the world in this single-player RPG about being a 90's kid.

In Yaga, play as Ivan, a one-handed blacksmith with incredibly bad luck, who must take on the impossible tasks given to him by the tzar. All the while the mysterious witch, Baba Yaga, watches over Ivan's fate.

Our second-to-last spotlight is for Faeria, a strategy game like no other. Build exciting decks and shape the battlefield as you fight epic battles. Raise mountains, build forests, fill lakes, or harness the sands of the deserts. You choose your own path to victory.

Finally, there's MOTHERGUNSHIP, a bullet-hell FPS where you craft your own guns, fight gigantic bosses, and defeat a robotic alien armada that conquered Earth. Face off against overwhelming odds in brutal, non-stop combats where thinking on your feet is the only way to survive.

If any of these titles sound enticing, they're on sale for a limited time until March 6th, so don't wait!

Hello, everyone!

Versus Evil is turning 8! Can you believe it? Well, believe it because to celebrate we're having a sale on our awesome [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/VersusEvil]catalog[/url] of games!

Tomorrow sees the release of our latest addition, UnMetal!

UnMetal is a 2D stealth action-adventure that pays homage to the classics with a healthy dose of humor and satire. You play as Jesse Fox, who is definitely NOT an elite commando, under arrest for a crime he didn't commit, and must escape a covert military base using his wits and fists.

Sounds like fun, right? Check out UnMetal and the rest of our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/VersusEvil]catalog[/url] for anything that may interest you!

To close, some thanks are in order...

Thank you to our developers who really give it their all to bring these games to life.

Thank you to our Heralds who are the best ambassadors we could ever hope for.

And, of course, thank you to our players who are the reason we continue to strive to put out the best games we possibly can. This has been one long, crazy journey, and we're glad you're all on it with us.

From all of us at Versus Evil, thank you for making these past 8 years great. Now, go score some deals!

notes.title: Antihero 1.0.23 - NEW MAP; RUSSIAN & JAPANESE SUPPORT

This update brings a new multiplayer/skirmish map, Russian and Japanese language support, and more!

"The Wharf" was the very first multiplayer map I built, and it's probably the most divisive one in the game. It's smaller than average and requires 5 victory points instead of 6, and I've received complaints that it doesn't feel strategically rich enough. notes.title: Antihero 1.0.20 - March 2018 - THE POWDER HOUSE UPDATE
notes.content:
Fans of saboteurs and traps rejoice: your favorite explosives expert just got some new tricks!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26873388/bbacc72b1fff34fadd6bd6936a181e14248a6c39.jpg[/img]

The "Powder House" is a new infiltratable building that can appear on all multiplayer and AI skirmish maps. A level 1 Powder House will give you a discount to Saboteur recruitment, similar to the Orphanage and Strangefellows Lodge. At level 2, the Powder House upgrades the Saboteur's traps, causing them to steal a Lantern, rather than a Coin, from any opponent unlucky enough to stumble into one.

Additionally, each multiplayer map's building distribution has been changed - when a Powder House appears on a map, it takes the slot of a building that otherwise would've been there. You can no longer count on a fixed set of buildings appearing on a given map, which shakes things up further.

[b]CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*](New) "The Powder House" building type
[*](New) Changed building distribution on all multiplayer/skirmish maps
[*](UI) The "Attack?" action prompt now shows a skull icon when the attack will kill the target, and a sword icon when it will wound them.
[*](Fix) Display the proper bribe number in the "Bribe Acquired!" animation
[*](Fix) Fix a rare "Misfortune!" error that could occur when closing the Live Match dialog.
[/list]

We welcome your comments and criticisms! You can reach us at bugs@antihero-game.com, on the Antihero Discord channel (https://discord.gg/DAKWppS) , and anywhere else fine thieving simulators are sold.

Also happy to share that we're on sale for the next week to celebrate the new update! Enjoy and happy thieving!

notes.title: Antihero 1.0.3 - July 28, 2017 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Antihero 1.0.3 - July 28, 2017

This build brings BALANCE CHANGES, QUALITY-OF-LIFE improvements, and LEADERBOARD UPDATES. All in-progress casual matches and skirmishes have been reset - this is necessary when we change game rules, to prevent games from being in broken states. (But we'll do this as infrequently as possible, and always give you a heads-up beforehand.)

[h1]CHANGES:[/h1]
[list]
[*](Balance) Units can now move through their own guild house. This makes it easier to escape when an opponent tries to box you in with their thugs.
[*](Balance) Traps in Guard Towers and The Palace get removed when the Palace is burgled.
[*](Leaderboards) "Skill" leaderboards are now available for Casual and Live Match modes. The Skill leaderboards show your matchmaking rank value. We use a TrueSkill-like system for calculating player skill. Skill is not directly related to your number of wins - a player with a high number of both wins and losses may have a lower skill ranking than another player with a lower number of wins but very few losses. (The server has been calculating player skill since the game launched, so the skill values you see today account for all match history.)
[*](UI) "Transparent Buildings" hotkey. While this key is held, buildings become transparent, making it easier to see where your opponent has scouted. (You'll need to add a keybinding in the Keyboard Controls dialog.)
[*](UI) Clicking on an unscouted tile that you can't reach will show you the tiles you need to scout to get there, in grey.
[*](Fix) "-", "^", and "\" can now be typed in Live Mode chat
[*]Several other minor UI tweaks and bugfixes
[/list]
As always, we welcome your comments and criticisms! The best way to get in touch with us is via the Antihero Steam forums, or by emailing bugs@antihero-game.com

Thanks!

notes.title: Looking Ahead - Roadmap
notes.content:
Looking Ahead for Antihero

First off, thank you all for the amazing Launch Day! It’s great to see people enjoy the game after 4 years of development. I can’t thank you enough for sharing the game and giving us feedback.

Secondly, please know that we are listening to all that feedback! We’d like this game to live a very long and happy life, and that means ongoing maintenance, improvement, and expansion. We’ll start with a minor patch that’ll come this Thursday to address some low-hanging fruit:

[h1]This week:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]More secret codes... 
    [*]The Black Plague will begin spreading! 
    [*]Minor bug fixes (97.43% of you never saw them - for those that did, you didn’t see them either)
    [*]DLC fixes (we had some hiccups that affected a small number of players)
    [*]Ability to skip turn-end animations
[/list]

[h1]Looking forward to the near future, this is what we’ll be addressing:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]In-game manual
    [*]Rebindable hotkeys
    [*]Animation speed improvements
    [*]More maps!
    [*]A 2v2 or FFA style map for more players.
    [*]Localization
    [*]AI changes. (This’ll be ongoing - there are a few places where the AI seems to be giving people too much trouble, and a few where it doesn’t give them enough!)
[/list]

Some of these future changes will take more time than others, and our priorities may change based on other feedback and yadda yadda yadda. But this is generally the direction we’ll be proceeding in!

--Tim and his gang

notes.title: Launch Trailer and Multiplayer Modes!
notes.content:
Hello All! 

We're 3 days away from launch and we wanted to ensure everyone had a good idea of what our multiplayer matches look like and how they work - as well as share our new launch trailer! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n6ZYAlfOIRQ 

Currently all of our multiplayer maps are 1v1, and we have multiple ways for you to play.

[h1]Live Matches[/h1] 
Live Match mode is where you will be playing against another person "live" and with turn timers. This is similar to how Hearthstone and many other turn-based board game and card games work. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26873388/5124aeef661223ab76d2e88bad44047334e09d18.png[/img]

[h1]Casual Matches[/h1]
In the game's Casual Match mode, there are no timers, you can have multiple games going at once, and your opponent doesn't have to be online at the same time. Games play out over several days, and you'll get an e-mail (and an in-game notification, if you're online) when it's your turn again.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26873388/7ecbf70e6f96a25543e7922c36fafe8c5724a0c5.png[/img]

[h1]Hotseat[/h1]
In Hotseat mode, you play against a friend on the same computer - no internet connection required. Also, if you catch your opponent peeking at the screen during your turn, you're allowed to steal all the money in their real-life wallet.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26873388/81202f933624c5690bd04f559367467da1d17156.png[/img]

[h1]Custom Rules[/h1]
Automatch games are ranked and have associated leaderboards. But if you're playing an invite game with a friend, you have the option to customize the game's rules. If this is popular, we'll add more rules-customization options based on community feedback!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26873388/3f04a7068919cd6e7eb0f49ac67d28f1f1027b0e.png[/img]

We're looking forward to seeing all of you folks on Monday! 

-Antihero Gang

We've had some unfortunate things come up with the Dev Team that have impacted our schedule, but we're still working away on the game and getting everything ready for our launch. 

We have our first access still open on Itch.Io where we're collecting a lot of great early feedback that is helping shape plus balance the game better before release too. 

Here's a sneak peek at one of our unseen multiplayer maps - The Palace! 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26873388/b6f54f3c13a0ea5be7a4e888fb9a04e3cf580d22.png[/img]

Thanks again for all of the support along the way and we're looking forward to July. If you have any questions, please feel free to ask away.

Remember, if you preorder on Steam now you'll get our first DLC Pack "The Book Club" for free! 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26873388/547465dd7922c571c5be8c11ac35b1eada9c0039.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Antihero Pre-Order Now Live
notes.content:
Hello! 

Our Steam Pre-Order is now live and we're offering a few bonuses for those of you who choose to pre-order the game! 

First off, we have a 20% discount which knocks off a few bucks. (Who doesn't love a good deal?)

Secondly, we're going to give all of our pre-order friends our first Master Thief DLC pack for free! “The Book Club” Master Thief Character Pack contains four Master Thief skins based on well-known literary characters: Miss Alice, Ebeneezer Scrooge, Sherlock Holmes, and Tiny Tim.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26873388/547465dd7922c571c5be8c11ac35b1eada9c0039.jpg[/img]

We also have some exciting news to share. Antihero is the featured game in the 2017 Versus Evil Charity Clash. This Charity Clash will take place between now and PAX East, pitting 4 worthwhile charities against each other in a bid to win a $10,000 donation from Versus Evil -- these charities include: GameChanger, Save the Children, Operation Supply Drop and St Jude. Each charity will be represented by various Twitch streamers who will be battling it out to see who can become the ultimate 'Master Thief'. Learn more via http://antihero.tiltify.com/ and be sure to watch your favorite Twitch streamers and root for them in their matches! 

Thank you all for the feedback, support, and kind words thus far. We’re getting near to release and we look forward to playing some matches against you in Antihero! 

Please also enjoy our latest trailer at the link below! 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ldQHEazG4X0

notes.title: Antihero Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Antihero’s Steam page is now live! The game hasn’t launched yet, but this is a big step towards building our Steam community, which is vital for a multiplayer game.

Most of our recent development time has been spent on content, rather than systems — Antihero’s core mechanics may change in minor ways before launch, but they’re essentially (and finally!) complete. The team’s primary focus is creating new scenarios that tweak the game’s rules in small but meaningful ways – we’ve recently wrapped up work on The Wharf, which sees you infiltrating steamships that arrive at the docks loaded with valuable goods.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26873388/1bcc4d91cb1f2e1b88c674f518fd03826a746dcb.jpg[/img]

The Wharf adds some new twists to the core Antihero formula, and it’s been a lot of fun to playtest. Importantly, it’s also pointed us towards other ways that the game can be expanded: we’re currently putting the finishing touches on another scenario that takes place in a much different part of the city, and that I’m extremely excited about – visually, narratively, and mechanically, it’s going to be great. Stay tuned!
